content: Gote-me naa ma-redepo yalisa
Gore naame Gote-na agale lo robaa-para mea wima-pulu nipumi naa ma-redepo yalisa. Go pea-pulu naana Mudu Ali Yesu Keriso-me naa kuma pi kone gisa-daa Gote raapu epe-rupa pima.
Yesuna agale madaa naame kone rulaemare Yesumi Gote-na epe raba meape kone naa piri-para mea ipisa. Go pea-pulu Gote-na epe paana puri medaloma ginalo naa raaname komoma adoba piramina.
Go puma kedaa epalia rabu go kedaame naana kone rulaere puri mapalaanalo raaname komamina.
Go puri paloma rekape konere Gote-me naa madaa epe kone su aaya. Go epe kone yalaaya-pulu naame epe-rupa adoba piramina.
Go adoba piralima raburi Gote-me naa epe kone gilia-pulu yala napotema. Gote-na pa ele gisare Holi Spirit naana lo robaa-para rubitabena sa. Go pea-le yala napole piramina.
Naa puri napale pirisima rabu Gote-me nipuna gole Yesumi pupitagi ne enaalinu raba minalo komena giyesa.
Gore ali meda epe ali raba mulalo komalia-daare mada yaade. Go pea pare pa ali medamere go-rupa mada palia ya? Nipu ora epe ali raba minalo mada komalia palo maarea.
Pare naa pupitagi ne enaali pirisima raburi page Gote-me naa madaa pedo puma raaname komisa-pulu Yesumi naa koe enaalinu madaa komaasa.
Nipu komisa-pulu nipumi Gote-na le agaa madaare naa epe redepo le enaali-rupa ma-aulaaya. Go pea-pulu werepe Gote-me rono pagape agale loma kose lape agale tea raburi Yesumi naa waru raba mealia.
Gore abalare naa Gote-na lore alinu pirisima pare nipuna Si komisa-pulu nipumi naa Gote-na adami enaalinu mapiraaya. Gore abi Gote-na adami enaalinu pima Yesumi naa ade abuna kagaa piramala palia.
Go pea pare gu-rupa kama-daa dia. Naana Mudu Ali Yesu Keriso-me naa Gote-na adami enaalinu mapiraasa-pulu naame Gote madaa ora raaname komamina.
Adam-me komape ele mea ipisa pare Yesumi kagaa pirape ele mea epea
Ali komea Adam-me pupitagi nisa-pulu su kamaa piri enaali madaa komape ele mea ipisa. Go pea-pulu enaali raayome pupitagi nisimi-pulu su kamaa piri enaali raayome komape pora-para pirisimi.
Gore Moses-na rekena agale nawisa rabu go su kamaa pirisimide enaalinumi koe ele pisimi. Go pisa pare rekena agale nawisa-pulu Gote-me enaalinuna koe elenu nayarepeasade.

Pare Adam pirisa rabu page komaoma ipuma Moses pirisa rabu page komape konemere enaali raayo rabuaanaalisa. Adam-me Gote-na agale mana raluma komisa pare komape koneme pupitagi go-rupa nanisimide enaalinu page rabuaanaalisa. Adam abala epenaloma Yesu nipu werepe su kamaa ipisa.

Nipu laapo kone rado rado wisipi pare Adam-re nipu werepe epaliade Yesuna piksa wasupa nona pirisa. Go pea pare apo ali laapo komea piale napirisipi. Dia-le Gote-na pa gi elere Adam-na koe ele madaa ora raayo mea kalisa. Go ali komeame pupitagi nisa-pulu enaali adaapu pa komape kone misimi. Yapare Gote-me kodo pi kone ora adaalepe wisa-pulu go ali Yesu Keriso naa raba minalo mea rapasa. Gote-me go pa kode gi elere enaali raayo mea kalisa.

Go pea-le Gote-na pa gi elere mo ali medana pupitagi nape kone-rupadaa dia. Go pea-le mo ali komeame pupitagi nenaloma Gote-me enaalinu-para koe kedaa mealimi lo lakalisa. Go pisa pare enaali raayome pupitagi adaapu no pirualimiri Gote-me mada tia pare nimi ma-redepo ta pea.

Gore mo Adam-me pupitagi nisa-pulu komape koneme naa rabuaanaalisa. Go pisa pare go ali meda Yesu Keriso-me kogono ora adaalepe pisa rabu Gote-me naa waru raba misa. Enaali raayome Keriso-na raba meape kone muma nipuna ma-redepo yape kone page pa mealimiri nimu ade abuna kagaa piramala palimi.
Go pea-le pupitagi nape kone komeame enaali raayo Gote-me komape elere mea kalisa. Go yapare Keriso-na epe kogono komeame enaali raayo mea kepenaloma ade abuna kagaa piramala palimi.
Go page ali komeame Gote-na agale ralisa-pulu enaali adaapumi pupitagi nisimi. Go yapare ali komea Yesumi Gote agale pagisa-pulu Gote-me enaalinu ma-redepo yalisa.
Gore enaalinumi koe ele waru pisimi-daa Gote-me Moses-na rekena agale lakalisa. Go puma enaalinumi pupitagi waru nisimi rabu Gote-me raba meape kone page waru gisa.
Go pea-le abala enaalinumi pupitagi noma komape kone saapiraama pisimiri abi Gote-me naa raba muma ma-redepo yaalia-pulu Mudu Ali Yesu Keriso-me naa ade abuna kagaa piramala pope kone gialia.
